verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a documented durable message queue that delivers requests to a device "immediately or the next time it's online" (formant-docs-52). That gives some offline-tolerant recovery, but only for cloud-to-device commands. Custom agent data directories (formant-docs-41) hint at local storage but do not describe buffering during outages. Bandwidth limits and adapter auto-restart are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented local buffering of telemetry/assets during connectivity loss, store-and-forward upload with backfill on reconnect, evidence that robots continue operating autonomously while offline, clean-recovery and data-integrity guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
